NOT generated by running any binding — expectations produced by the code
under test would only prove that code agrees with itself.

notes: VXX is an index/breadth symbol per semantics.md §3, so its bid/ask MUST be
null even though the wire carries 449.99/450.01 like every other frame.
This is the rule a new binding is most likely to miss, and the reason this
seq is per-symbol and shared between kinds (semantics.md §6.1): SPY runs
1, 2, 3 with the bar_1m taking 3. All six frames carry one sid.
The bar's bucket_start is not minute-aligned because the harness reuses the
tick timestamp for EL_PublishTickEx. Real EL supplies a bar-aligned time.
Bindings must not 'correct' this — ts_str is authoritative verbatim.
Only wire-derivable fields are asserted. Anything a binding computes on top
(VWAP, session tagging, aggregation) is outside the contract.
